title: Bounded support of the affine finite-free model
statement: For the explicit affine finite-free model, if K_n is zero for n > r then the transported cochain complex is zero outside degrees [-r,0].

source.place: Tag 068C, affine finite free resolution argument

proof.text: Choose a = -(r : ℤ) and b = 0. Unfold affineFiniteFreeModelComplex and use Functor.map_isZero for the inverse over-site equivalence. For n < -r, set i = (-n).toNat; integer arithmetic gives embeddingDownNat.f i = n and r < i. HomologicalComplex.extendXIso identifies the extended term with the sheafification and restriction of K.X i, which is zero by hzero and Functor.map_isZero. For 0 < n, no natural i satisfies -i = n, so HomologicalComplex.isZero_extend_X gives zero directly.

proof_origin.place: Tag 068C, extension-by-zero support calculation; Mathlib HomologicalComplex.extendXIso, isZero_extend_X and Functor.map_isZero

theorem affine_finite_free_model_bounded {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (K : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U) : Type u)) ℕ) (r : ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ n, r < n → IsZero (K.X n)) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n →
      IsZero ((affineFiniteFreeModelComplex U hU K).X n)
